description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.requirements: Upgrade Java JDK to version 21 (latest LTS), update build configuration (pom.xml/build.gradle), resolve any compatibility issues with newer Java APIs and language features
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded Java from 1.8 to 21 LTS. Updated maven.compiler.source/target to 21, upgraded Jetty 9 to 11 (Jakarta EE 9 namespace support), migrated javax.servlet.* and javax.websocket.* imports to jakarta.* in RabbitMQConsumer.java and NewsWebSocket.java, upgraded maven-compiler-plugin to 3.13.0 and surefire to 3.2.5. Build passes and unit tests pass.

tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot to version 3.4 (latest stable), upgrade Spring Framework to 6.x, migrate javax.* packages to jakarta.* namespace, update Spring Boot dependencies and configuration properties, resolve breaking changes in Spring Boot 3.x
tasks.taskSummary: Migrated demo project from traditional Jakarta EE WAR to Spring Boot 3.4.5 (Spring Framework 6.2.x). Added spring-boot-starter-parent 3.4.5, changed packaging to jar (embedded Tomcat), added spring-boot-starter-web and spring-boot-starter-websocket, created DemoApplication.java entry point and WebSocketConfig.java for JSR-356 support. Refactored RabbitMQConsumer from @WebListener/ServletContextListener to @Component/@PostConstruct/@PreDestroy. Build passes, unit tests pass, CodeQL 0 alerts.
